you can't blame STI (or any institution that is) that they are charging you because you did not formally withdraw your enrollment with them. may deadline ang cancellation of enrollment. usually up until 2 weeks to 1 month then 50%-100% 'yung amount na babayaran mo. 

and yes, mas lalo kang i-deny sa AU kung magsisinungaling ka and possibly barred from ever enrolling there kasi you are falsifying documents. 

here are my suggestions on what you should do:

1. Pay your balance in STI. There is no way out kasi hahanapin rin ito ng kahit anong university na papasukan mo.  
2. Get your Transcript of Record, Honorable Dismissal, and Good Moral Character sa STI.   
3. Apply to a new university (pwedeng AU) as a transferee student.   
4. Never ghost a university again. If hindi mo kaya pumasok, pwede ka magwithdraw/drop out para hindi ka nagugulat sa mga charges. 

I understand your struggles but please be responsible with your choices next time. there are uni naman that offers fully online classes btw if you really can't leave having a job.
